hypotheses.justification: Split on f = 0. In the zero case, hDf and AlgebraicCurve.Place.ord_zero (Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean:125) give Df v = 0 for every v, so both finite sums are zero, including when the indexing types or sets are empty. In the nonzero case, the existing proof applies unchanged.
